brief: Declares a WebSocket client built on libcurl, which cannot open a connection today because libcurl is no longer loaded.
detail: The rest of the network layer moved to the in-tree engine, but this class still calls curl functions (curl_easy_init, curl_ws_send, curl_ws_recv) that the library does not define. Connect therefore raises error R3, no connection is ever open, and every other call answers as an unconnected client: the send and receive calls set LastError to Not connected. The callback setters store names that are never called. Use stzTcpClient for a raw socket until the class is rewired to the engine.
